programme.title: ESPN DOC. Goran Popov – Positive Bad Boy
programme.desc: Goran Popov only played for SC Heerenveen for two seasons, but left an indelible impression in Friesland during that period. A cult hero for some, reviled by others. The Macedonian international was important for the club within the lines, but controversial outside of it. programme.title: Football: World Cup 2026 – Round of 16 match: Portugal – Croatia
programme.desc: The most interesting match of the 1/16 finals. The Croatians, medalists of the two previous world championships, recorded results in the group phase that were consistent with experts' predictions. They lost to the English (2:4) and defeated Panama (1:0) and Ghana (2:1). The Firemen are considered a tournament team that shows its full football potential when it is necessary. The match against Portugal will certainly require Luka Modric and company to reach the heights of their skills. Robert Martinez's team won only one of three matches in group K, and as a result, Colombia overtook them in the table. This does not mean, however, that the team from the Iberian Peninsula cannot achieve success in the American tournament. After all, it has many football stars in its squad who can single-handedly decide the fate of the match. The biggest of them is, of course, Cristiano Ronaldo. Striker Al-Nassr has already made football history as the one who scored in six World Cups

programme.title: I was the king – Paweł Brożek | S01E05
programme.desc: A series presenting the profiles of the best scorers in the history of the Premier League. This is a great opportunity to recall the successes of Włodzimierz Lubański, Grzegorz Lata, Kazimierz Kmiecik, Grzegorz Piechna and Tomasz Frankowski. We will get to know different football generations. In the 1960s, Włodzimierz Lubański (Górnik Zabrze) was the top scorer four times in a row. However, in the 1970s, Kazimierz Kmiecik (Wisła Kraków) and Grzegorz Lato (Stal Mielec) reigned supreme. In more modern times, Tomasz Frankowski won four titles in the colors of Wisła Kraków and Jagiellonia Białystok. There will also be the story of Grzegorz Piechna, the unexpected top scorer from Korona Kielce in 2006. Paweł Brożek scored 149 goals in the Polish Ekstraklasa. This places him in eighth place in the all-time ranking of the highest league in our country. His goals contributed to Wisła Kraków winning seven Polish champion titles. Paweł Brożek became the top scorer twice. Poland. 2022-2025. documentary series

programme.desc: Stories of people who encountered and recorded the most dangerous weather phenomena. Great Britain. 2018. documentary series

programme.title: Big Brother Oasis | E03
programme.desc: A nature series devoted to the world's first artificial waterhole and the animals that use it. It was created in a reserve in Tanzania, an area of ​​the African savannah with poor water resources. It is not only an excellent vantage point for hidden cameras, but also a place of respite for wild animals such as lions, baboons, elephants, giraffes and buffalos. Thanks to hidden cameras, scientists want to track the secret behaviors of creatures gathering around the waterhole. They are wondering, among other things: whether half-year changes affect their customs and how predators and their prey coexist on a daily basis. It's raining again on the savannah. Animals using watering holes must prepare for changes. New species of creatures arrive in their areas. Among them are huge herds of migrating wildebeest. They put pressure on the hyenas. Great Britain, USA. 2020. nature series

programme.desc: «Plus+ Report. Muriqi the pirate of Kosovo» Vedat Muriqi represents an endangered species. He is the classic number nine, finisher, all-powerful in the attack of Mallorca and its team, Kosovo. But his story goes beyond mere sporting success. On his path to stardom he had to overcome the conflict that would ravage his country in the late nineties and a post-war period that was almost more complicated than the conflict itself.

programme.title: Plus+ Report. Muriqi the pirate of Kosovo
programme.desc: «The league of... (T1): Modern times» The model of presidents that triumphed in the 90s is overwhelmed by the emergence of modern football personified in Florentino Pérez. Our presidents are out of the game. Lendoiro and Caneda, who have starred in the golden years of Deportivo and Compostela, leave the presidency. The bad results arrive, the party ends and the hangover appears: the debts accumulated after years of living beyond their means bring many clubs to the brink of disappearance. Large fortunes and foreign investment groups take advantage of these desperate situations, professionalizing the clubs while distancing them from their fans. After being considered demigods, our presidents end up leaving through the back door, but 30 years later they continue to occupy a very special place in collective memory

programme.title: The League of Extraordinary Gentlemen: Modern Times
programme.desc: «Plus+ Report. Nayanesh. The scars of a lion » Nayanesh Ayman is much more than a Muay Thai legend. The Spaniard of Congolese origin has turned his career into a personal fight against sexist violence. 'Nenés', as they call him in his neighborhood of Alcorcón, was a victim of abuse with his mother when he was just a child, and began to fight "so that no one would lay a hand on his mother again." Today Nayanesh is a double world champion and wants to continue making history as one of the most important fighters in history, and a great reference in terms of values.

programme.title: Plus+ Report. Nayanesh. The scars of a lion

programme.title: Merckx: the cannibal of cycling
programme.desc: «Charles Thomas: time out» Charles Thomas was a Barça basketball star in the 70s, but after an injury in a match against Madrid he fell from grace and one day disappeared without a trace. They thought he was dead, but 40 years later his best friend and teammate, Norman Carmichael, received a call that would change everything.

programme.title: Charles Thomas: time out
programme.desc: «Plus+ Report. Delibasic: The teacher of Sarajevo» The Bosnian Mirza Delibasic was part of an unforgettable generation of Yugoslav basketball players. Those who were his teammates at Real Madrid in the early 80s remember him as a teacher, for his class and generosity on and off the field. During the siege of his beloved Sarajevo, which began 30 years ago, in April 1992, and with his health very deteriorated, the teacher showed that he also had a hero inside.

programme.title: Plus+ Report. Delibasic: The master of Sarajevo

programme.desc: «90 years of LaLiga (2019): Paco Gento» Francisco Gento López, better known as Paco Gento, is living history of Real Madrid and European and world football. He holds the record of being the player who has won the most European Cups, six, and has the most League Championship titles, twelve. He arrived at the white club when he was 18 years old and after 18 consecutive seasons he closed the most brilliant and still valid record in the history of LaLiga. His younger brothers Julio and Antonio also played in the First Division and over time, another family generation emerged, the Llorente-Gento dedicated to the world of sports. José Luis and Toñín, the two oldest, became very visible in the world of basketball while Paco and Julio Llorente opted for football. A fourth generation of athletes in the Llorente-Gento family keeps the flame alive with Marcos Llorente, current Real Madrid first team player

programme.title: 90 years of stories (T2019): Paco Gento
programme.desc: «The Others (2): Spain before Tiquitaca» Before the world baptized Spain as the country of tiqui-taca, before being short didn't matter or goalkeepers knew how to play with their feet, Spanish football lived another reality. Other times marked by wild tackles, mud fields, permissive refereeing, harshness and violence. But they were not necessarily worse times. The Others immerses itself fully in an era unknown to millions of fans and full of incredible stories and characters that belong to a Spanish football that is difficult to recognize today.

Malawi Wildlife Rescue: A Pangolin's Plight (S2E5). Documentary about nature. England, 2022. S2, Ep5
programme.desc: 2022 г. Год: 2022. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2022. S2, Ep5 «Malawi Wildlife Rescue»…Feel heartbreak when Dr. Amanda's team loses a pangolin abused by wildlife traffickers, but cheer when another is released post-rehab. Check on a trio of hedgehogs and tag along as the centre's baboons and nyala antelopes get a change of sceneryMalawi is a small African country that has made a big push to protect its wildlife. Leading the effort is American veterinarian Dr. Amanda Salb and her colleagues at the country's only animal rescue center, where injured and abandoned creatures are saved and rehabilitated. This six-part series follows the dedicated team as they care for a variety of patients, including vervet monkeys, bulbuls, baboons, hedgehogs, and many more, often working with limited resources and in dangerous conditions as they prepare the animals to return to the wildDirector: Andie ClareCast: Helen Baxendale, Amanda Salb, Torie Curr Smith

A pudgy wolf eel, naked mole rat, and hideous sea lamprey may be superficially grotesque, but they're evolutionarily amazingDocumentary series is dedicated to the majestic Animal Kingdom and its weirdest, most unusual creatures. Nature never stops surprising us with its unique species and evolutionary unlike living things. Have a look at species with extraordinary survival skills, animals who camouflage in a skillful way for different reasons, creatures that convincingly play dead, find out if a grasshopper can vomit. programme.desc: 2023 г. Год: 2023. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2023. S3, Ep3 «Orangutan Jungle School»…Shudder as food-obsessed Beni gets a dramatic, educational smackdown from the local dominant male, Petruk. See spoiled rich kid Spanser, a former illegal pet, try to tamp down his sweet tooth before roguish Bumi goes on a wild joyride with GretaCaptivating documentary series that follows the work of the Nyaru Menteng Orangutan Rescue Centre in Borneo, Indonesia, which is the largest orangutan rehabilitation centre in the world. People who work here are dedicated to rescuing orangutans that have been displaced from their habitat or kept as illegal pets, and they do their best to help them adjust and teach them the skills necessary to survive on their own when they return to the jungle. Hear some incredible stories and follow the antics, triumphs and tragedies of a group of orphaned orangutans as they go through «Orangutan Jungle School»Director: Judith CurranCast: Rebecca Parr

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends: The Young Ones (S1E3). Documentary about nature. England, 2020. S1, Ep3
programme.desc: 2020 г. Год: 2020. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2020. S1, Ep3 «Amazing Animal Friends»…The instinct to protect young ones is hard to suppress. Marvel at the way animals, both male and female, care for babies of other species. Meet a lonely rabbit who babysits lambs, and a little rescued rhino who finds encouragement from a playful dogAmazing Animal Friends is a heart-warming, fun and fascinating series showcasing the most incredible stories of unusual animal friendships from around the world. From an orphaned rhino calf and her dog and sheep companions in South Africa, to the duck who's obsessed with a dog in France and the elephant who thinks she's a buffalo in Zimbabwe, we reveal the cutest, funniest and unexpected animal relationships in the world. The series discovers what brings these species together, explores how they form their extraordinary bonds and examines the behaviours that influence and affect each relationshipDirector: Justin Purefoy, Chris HarriesCast: Allison Hedgecoth, Kingsley Lara

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends: The Young Ones (S1E3). Documentary about nature. England, 2020. S1, Ep3
programme.desc: 2020 г. Год: 2020. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2020. S1, Ep3 «Amazing Animal Friends»…The instinct to protect young ones is hard to suppress. Marvel at the way animals, both male and female, care for babies of other species. Meet a lonely rabbit who babysits lambs, and a little rescued rhino who finds encouragement from a playful dogAmazing Animal Friends is a heart-warming, fun and fascinating series showcasing the most incredible stories of unusual animal friendships from around the world. From an orphaned rhino calf and her dog and sheep companions in South Africa, to the duck who's obsessed with a dog in France and the elephant who thinks she's a buffalo in Zimbabwe, we reveal the cutest, funniest and unexpected animal relationships in the world. The series discovers what brings these species together, explores how they form their extraordinary bonds and examines the behaviours that influence and affect each relationshipDirector: Justin Purefoy, Chris HarriesCast: Allison Hedgecoth, Kingsley Lara

programme.title: Island of the Monsoon: Queen of Yala (S1E1). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Anglija, 2018. S1, Ep1
programme.desc: 2018 г. Год: 2018. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2018. S1 «Island of the Monsoon»…The shadowy forests of Yala National Park are the perfect hideout for secretive leopards. It's time for one young female, Asha, to strike out alone. Join her as she fights for her own territory, finds a mate, and becomes a motherIsland of the Monsoon is a nature documentary series exploring the wildlife on the island of Sri Lanka, a home to a variety of amazing animal species. They live in extreme weather conditions, from the tropical rainforests to the dry lowlands and mountain tops facing monsoons. Follow the stories of individual creatures on this unique island, as they hunt, mate and adapt to survive, from a newborn elephant to dangerous predators like leopards and crocodilesDirector: Hannah HoareCast: Robert Blythe

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue: A Pangolin's Plight (S2E5). Documentary about nature. England, 2022. S2, Ep5
programme.desc: 2022 г. Год: 2022. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2022. S2, Ep5 «Malawi Wildlife Rescue»…Feel heartbreak when Dr. Amanda's team loses a pangolin abused by wildlife traffickers, but cheer when another is released post-rehab. Check on a trio of hedgehogs and tag along as the centre's baboons and nyala antelopes get a change of sceneryMalawi is a small African country that has made a big push to protect its wildlife. Leading the effort is American veterinarian Dr. Amanda Salb and her colleagues at the country's only animal rescue center, where injured and abandoned creatures are saved and rehabilitated. This six-part series follows the dedicated team as they care for a variety of patients, including vervet monkeys, bulbuls, baboons, hedgehogs, and many more, often working with limited resources and in dangerous conditions as they prepare the animals to return to the wildDirector: Andie ClareCast: Helen Baxendale, Amanda Salb, Torie Curr Smith

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue: Three Kings Islands/ Manawatāwhi (S1E5). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Naujoji Zelandija, 2022. S1, Ep5
programme.desc: 2022 г. Год: 2022. Страна: Naujoji Zelandija. Год: 2022. S1, Ep5 «Beasts of the Big Blue»…Delve into the strange magic of the Three Kings Islands, a remote archipelago north of New Zealand. Swim with a pod of bottlenose dolphins, join short-tailed stingrays on a hunt, and feel the tension as a gang of predatory orcas arrives on the sceneFollow Journey from the Cook Islands to the Antarctic seas and meet astounding sea creatures, from tiny argonauts to bus-sized manta rays, along the way

S3, Ep3 «Orangutan Jungle School»…Shudder as food-obsessed Beni gets a dramatic, educational smackdown from the local dominant male, Petruk. People who work here are dedicated to rescuing orangutans that have been displaced from their habitat or kept as illegal pets, and they do their best to help them adjust and teach them the skills necessary to survive on their own when they return to the jungle.
